properties.property: ABI specifications from DApps MUST be treated as untrusted input
properties.formal_specification: FORALL abi: abi.source == EXT-DAPP => abi.trust_level == UNTRUSTED
properties.rationale: DApps can provide malicious ABIs that misrepresent actual contract functions

properties.property: Interface address matching MUST be case-sensitive
properties.formal_specification: FORALL interface, call: match(interface, call) => interface.address == call.to (exact string match)
properties.rationale: Case-sensitive matching prevents accidental mismatches with EIP-55 checksummed addresses

properties.property: Calldata decoding MUST only use ABIs that match target contract addresses
properties.formal_specification: FORALL decode: decode(calldata, abi) => interface_matches_call(abi, calldata.target)
properties.rationale: Using wrong ABI could decode calldata incorrectly and mislead users

properties.property: Interface specification version MUST be validated before use
properties.formal_specification: FORALL spec: use_spec(spec) => spec.version IN ['abi-v1', 'abi-v2']
properties.rationale: Unsupported versions could contain incompatible or malicious formats

properties.property: Wallets SHOULD validate ABI against trusted database when available
properties.formal_specification: FORALL abi, trusted_db: exists(trusted_db) => verify_abi(abi, trusted_db)
properties.rationale: Verification against trusted sources reduces risk of malicious ABIs

properties.property: Malicious ABI MUST NOT be able to make dangerous transactions appear benign
properties.formal_specification: FORALL display, actual: display.function != actual.function => user_warned(display, actual)
properties.rationale: Users could approve malicious transactions if display misrepresents actual function

properties.property: Wallet MUST clearly indicate when ABI source is unverified
properties.formal_specification: FORALL display: !abi_verified(display.abi) => display.shows_unverified_warning
properties.rationale: Users need to know trustworthiness of decoded transaction display

properties.property: TSTORE MUST fail with exception in STATICCALL context
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tstore: in_staticcall_context() AND execute(tstore) => THROWS static_context_violation
properties.rationale: Transient storage writes violate STATICCALL's read-only guarantee

properties.property: TSTORE MUST charge exactly 100 gas
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tstore: gas_cost(tstore) == 100
properties.rationale: Fixed 100 gas matches warm SSTORE of dirty slot, cheaper than cold storage

properties.property: TSTORE MUST write 32-byte value at 32-byte address in contract's transient storage
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tstore, addr, val: execute(tstore, addr, val) => transient_storage[contract][addr] == val
properties.rationale: Correct write semantics are essential for transient storage functionality

properties.property: TLOAD MUST charge exactly 100 gas
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tload: gas_cost(tload) == 100
properties.rationale: Fixed 100 gas matches hot SLOAD cost

properties.property: TLOAD from unset address MUST return zero
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tload, addr: !exists(transient_storage[contract][addr]) => tload(addr) == 0
properties.rationale: Zero-default behavior matches regular storage semantics

properties.property: TLOAD MUST be allowed in STATICCALL context (read-only operation)
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tload: in_staticcall_context() AND execute(tload) => succeeds
properties.rationale: Reads do not modify state and are allowed in static context

properties.property: Transient storage MUST be empty at transaction start
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tx: start(tx) => transient_storage == {}
properties.rationale: Clean slate ensures no data leakage between transactions

properties.property: All transient storage MUST be discarded at transaction end
properties.formal_specification: FORALL tx: end(tx) => transient_storage == {}
properties.rationale: Transient storage does not persist - this is its defining property

properties.property: Transient storage MUST be shared across all call frames in a transaction
properties.formal_specification: FORALL frame1, frame2: same_transaction(frame1, frame2) => frame1.transient_storage == frame2.transient_storage
properties.rationale: Transaction-wide persistence enables reentrancy locks and cross-call communication

properties.property: Reverted frame MUST rollback its transient storage changes
properties.formal_specification: FORALL frame: revert(frame) => transient_storage == pre_frame_transient_storage
properties.rationale: Revert semantics must apply to transient storage like regular storage

properties.property: Regular CALL/STATICCALL MUST access callee's transient storage
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: call_type IN [CALL, STATICCALL] => transient_storage_owner == call.to
properties.rationale: Ownership follows normal call semantics - code runs in its own context

properties.property: DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE MUST access caller's transient storage
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: call_type IN [DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE] => transient_storage_owner == call.from
properties.rationale: Ownership follows delegate semantics - storage context is caller's

properties.property: Contract A MUST NOT be able to access contract B's transient storage directly
properties.formal_specification: FORALL A, B: A != B AND !delegate_context(A, B) => !can_access(A, B.transient_storage)
properties.rationale: Cross-contract storage isolation is a fundamental security property

properties.property: Maximum transient storage allocation MUST NOT cause OOM conditions
properties.formal_specification: ASSUMPTION: max_transient_storage_size <= available_client_memory
properties.rationale: ~9.15MB max per 30M gas transaction must fit in client memory

properties.property: Signature input (v, r, s) from caller MUST be treated as untrusted
properties.formal_specification: FORALL input: ecrecover_input(input) => input.trust_level == UNTRUSTED
properties.rationale: Malicious callers can provide crafted signatures to test recovery behavior

properties.property: Validation or recovery failure MUST return empty output, not revert
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: ecrecover_fails(call) => call.output == bytes(0) AND !call.reverted
properties.rationale: Empty return vs revert distinction is important for calling contracts

properties.property: Successful recovery MUST return 32-byte left-padded Ethereum address
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: ecrecover_succeeds(call) => len(call.output) == 32 AND call.output[0:12] == 0
properties.rationale: EVM expects 32-byte words; address occupies rightmost 20 bytes

properties.property: Recovery identifier v MUST be 27 or 28
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: valid_ecrecover(call) => call.v == 27 OR call.v == 28
properties.rationale: v determines which of two possible public keys to recover

properties.property: Signature component r MUST be in range (0, SECP256K1N)
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: valid_ecrecover(call) => 0 < call.r < SECP256K1N
properties.rationale: r outside valid range indicates invalid or malformed signature

properties.property: Signature component s MUST be in range (0, SECP256K1N)
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: valid_ecrecover(call) => 0 < call.s < SECP256K1N
properties.rationale: s outside valid range indicates invalid or malformed signature

properties.property: Invalid v, r, or s MUST cause early return with empty output
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: !valid_v(call) OR !valid_r(call) OR !valid_s(call) => call.output == bytes(0)
properties.rationale: Invalid parameters cannot produce meaningful recovery result

properties.property: Input less than 128 bytes MUST be zero-padded before processing
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: len(call.input) < 128 => padded_input == call.input + zeros(128 - len(call.input))
properties.rationale: Consistent handling of short input prevents undefined behavior

properties.property: Recovery MUST use trusted secp256k1 cryptographic library
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: ecrecover(call) USES trusted_secp256k1_library
properties.rationale: Cryptographic correctness depends on library implementation

properties.property: Address derivation MUST use Keccak256 hash of public key bytes 12-31
properties.formal_specification: FORALL pubkey: address(pubkey) == keccak256(pubkey)[12:32]
properties.rationale: Standard Ethereum address derivation ensures compatibility

properties.property: High-S values (s > SECP256K1N/2) are NOT rejected at precompile level
properties.formal_specification: FORALL call: call.s > SECP256K1N/2 => NOT rejected_by_ecrecover
properties.rationale: EIP-2 malleability fix applies at transaction level, not precompile

properties.property: Keccak256 MUST be collision-resistant for address derivation
properties.formal_specification: ASSUMPTION: !exists(pk1, pk2): pk1 != pk2 AND keccak256(pk1)[12:32] == keccak256(pk2)[12:32]
properties.rationale: Address collisions would allow impersonation attacks
